title: Cursor Pricing in 2026: Every Plan | Coworker AI

facts.fact: Since October 12, 2026, new Cursor customers buy plans through The X Subscription, with Plus priced at $8 a month.
facts.quote: Since October 12, 2026, new Cursor customers buy it through The X Subscription: Free, Plus at $8 a month, Premium at $30

facts.fact: The Premium plan on The X Subscription is priced at $30 a month.
facts.quote: Free, Plus at $8 a month, Premium at $30, Super at $100 and Ultra at $200

facts.fact: The Super plan on The X Subscription is priced at $100 a month.
facts.quote: Free, Plus at $8 a month, Premium at $30, Super at $100 and Ultra at $200

facts.fact: The Ultra plan on The X Subscription is priced at $200 a month.
facts.quote: Free, Plus at $8 a month, Premium at $30, Super at $100 and Ultra at $200

facts.fact: Cursor Teams seats on The X Subscription are priced at $30, $100 or $200 per user per month, and Enterprise is available on request.
facts.quote: with Teams seats at $30, $100 or $200 per user per month and Enterprise on request

facts.fact: Under legacy plans, Cursor's Pro plan was priced at $20 a month, Pro+ at $60 a month, and Teams at $40 or $120 per seat.
facts.quote: Pro $20, Pro+ $60, Ultra $200, and Teams at $40 or $120 per seat.

facts.fact: Annual billing for Cursor's Plus plan costs $80 a year.
facts.quote: Annual billing costs $80 a year for Plus, $300 for Premium, $1,000 for Super and $2,000 for Ultra

facts.fact: Annual billing for Cursor's Premium plan costs $300 a year.
facts.quote: Annual billing costs $80 a year for Plus, $300 for Premium, $1,000 for Super and $2,000 for Ultra

facts.fact: Annual billing for Cursor's Super plan costs $1,000 a year.
facts.quote: Annual billing costs $80 a year for Plus, $300 for Premium, $1,000 for Super and $2,000 for Ultra

facts.fact: Annual billing for Cursor's Ultra plan costs $2,000 a year.
facts.quote: Annual billing costs $80 a year for Plus, $300 for Premium, $1,000 for Super and $2,000 for Ultra

facts.fact: Cursor's listed plan prices exclude tax.
facts.quote: Prices exclude tax ([Cursor help]

facts.fact: Cursor states that Premium provides 4x Plus usage, Super 15x Plus usage, and Ultra 50x Plus usage.
facts.quote: 4x Plus usage; adds Cloud Agents, Automations, Bugbot, Origin, and third-party models at API list price from prepaid credit

facts.fact: Cursor's legacy Start plan (India only) is priced at ₹649 a month, tax inclusive.
facts.quote: Start (India only) | ₹649/month, tax inclusive | Plus ($8)

facts.fact: Third-party models such as Claude, GPT and Gemini are no longer included in any new Cursor plan.
facts.quote: Third-party models such as Claude, GPT and Gemini are no longer included in any new plan

facts.fact: On Premium and above, third-party models bill at API list price from prepaid credit.
facts.quote: on Premium and above they bill at API list price from prepaid credit

facts.fact: SpaceXAI states each new plan includes at least twice the coding usage with Cursor's own models as the plan it replaces (vendor claim, not verified by this page).
facts.quote: each new plan includes at least twice the coding usage with Cursor's own models as the plan it replaces

facts.fact: The weekly usage pool for Cursor's own models on The X Subscription refreshes every week rather than every billing cycle.
facts.quote: it refreshes every week rather than every billing cycle

facts.fact: Cursor's legacy plans are closed to new customers, and switching from a legacy plan to a new plan is permanent.
facts.quote: They are closed to new customers, but existing subscribers keep their plan, price and features unless they switch, and switching is permanent.
